attributes.context: Located in Article 18, Re-opener Provisions, under D. Enterprise Resource Project (ERP) – Modernization of Business Systems.

extraction_text: Notwithstanding any other provisions of this Agreement (with specific reference to Article 12), the Association agrees to meet and confer with the County upon request from the County regarding matters within the scope of representation pertaining to implementation of ERP software applications and IT issues and to re-open those provisions of this Agreement which may be affected.
